details:
Didn't find a better board to post this. I find it mildly annoying that the button "Reset Avatar" sitsbin the upper right section of the Action Menu's wheel.

The issue is that if you often change your height then you quickly earn a habit to double click in that upper right (first - to get to Expressions, second - to Quick Actions). But if you were already in the Expressions after opening wheel you your usual double click immediately lands on Reset Avatar which is probably not something you use often, especially in comparison to the height change. Does anyone else have such issue? 

Besides, if you have an avatar with a lot of customizations – clothes, hair, body proportions etc – then resetting them to zero is extremely annoying and if you accidentally open the Avatar Height it's easier to remember your previous height or just close the wheel when it opens while resetting an avatar is instant there obviously won't be any "are you sure?" prompts.
title: Moving the "Reset Avatar" to the right side of the wheel?
